verdict.rationale: Smooth's core interface is natural language. Tasks are plain-English instructions passed to `run()`, as in the quickstart's Google Flights example. Through the CLI, users simply ask Claude Code or another agent to do something on the web, and data extraction needs only a description of what you want. A community user confirms that writing a complex prompt worked well. Missing for 10: a standalone first-party conversational interface (natural-language use goes through the SDK/API code or a host agent), and independent corroboration is limited to one anecdote.
